description: Crosswalks between USDM and other standards, from the DDF-RA Documents/Mappings directory. Informative material, not one of the five official USDM standards.
caveat: DDF-RA Documents/README.md describes these as provisional and written against USDM v3.1x. That README is stale: both files declare USDM v4.0.0 in their own Readme sheet, verified 2026-08-17. m11_mapping is aligned to the M11 Updated Step 2 Draft of 14 March 2025, matching USDM-IG p.8. ct-gov_mapping carries a "v4.0 Change" column.
excluded: ctis_mapping.xlsx (EU registry, out of scope), cpt_mapping.xlsx (authoring template our sources do not use), sdtm_mapping.xlsx (USDM to SDTM, downstream and opposite direction).

files.name: m11_mapping.xlsx
files.role: Crosswalk from ICH M11 CeSHarP protocol template elements to USDM. M11 is an authoring template our source protocols are not written in, so this is reference material, not a pipeline input.

files.name: ct-gov_mapping.xlsx
files.role: Crosswalk from ClinicalTrials.gov registry fields to USDM. Directly relevant from Phase 1, since every study we fetch already has these registry fields populated.
